site.name: Orbital Economy Terminal
site.description: The Orbital Economy Intelligence terminal: one resolved record per physical satellite, stitched from SATCAT, GCAT and Space-Track decay messages, in a read-only public catalog with identifier crosswalks, operator attribution, cross-source conflicts, bus benchmarks, reachability and pending FCC filings.

routes.title: Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: What happened in orbit in the last 30 days — launch tempo, who owns the active fleet, the constellation race, reentries and space weather — over one resolved record per satellite stitched from SATCAT, GCAT and Space-Track decay messages.

routes.title: Resolver · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Search the resolved satellite catalog and read one object's full identity: every source's identifier crosswalk, its ownership over time, and where SATCAT, GCAT and Space-Track disagree.

routes.title: Conflicts · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Every cross-source disagreement the resolver had to adjudicate, from the data-quality report, with each row linking into the resolver so the underlying claims can be read.

routes.title: Operators · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: A league table of satellite operators over the resolved ownership graph, with each operator's hierarchy, fleet mix by status and orbital regime, and acquisition history.

routes.title: Review · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Hard identity cases the graph resolved under conflicting sources, in an arbitration workbench where a recorded verdict turns coverage into per-failure-mode accuracy.

routes.title: Bus benchmarks · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Spacecraft bus benchmarks per manufacturer and per bus model: fleet size, time to operational, station-keeping, lifetime and disposal, derived from GP element history with provenance and a published methodology.

routes.title: Reachability · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Every satellite above your horizon right now, computed from the latest GP elements for a spot on Earth, with the transmitters each one carries from SatNOGS and the next passes.

routes.title: Filings · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Pending FCC space-station applications from IBFS bulk data and harvested ICFS documents: the pre-launch pipeline of satellites that do not yet exist in any tracking catalog.
